c89dedd99e933b8e.description: About Qiddiya Investment Company Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Manager - Cost Planning to join its team. This full-time role requires over 12 years of experience and is integral to supporting Qiddiya’s cost planning requirements within assigned business units, development projects, and governance activities. Role Purpose and Context The Senior Manager, General BU Cost Planning, provides structured cost planning support, consultant coordination, Stage Gate review input, benchmarking analysis, and cost governance assistance. The primary objective is to ensure project budgets, cost plans, and design-to-budget decisions are evidence-based, consistent, and aligned with Qiddiya’s standards. This role operates within the Business Unit cost planning environment, supporting the application of Qiddiya Cost Planning Technical Guidelines, asset class guidelines, processes, benchmarking requirements, and digital tools. While external consultants may prepare detailed cost plans, the Senior Manager is responsible for reviewing assigned outputs, coordinating comments, maintaining records, and escalating key issues for review and decision-making. Key Responsibilities Coordinate cost planning activities for assigned projects, workstreams, business unit support, and development programmes. Support the implementation of Qiddiya Cost Planning Technical Guidelines, asset class guidelines, templates, trackers, reporting standards, and governance processes. Review and comment on cost consultant outputs, including cost plans, reconciliations, assumptions, risk allowances, benchmarks, cost reports, and design-to-budget recommendations. Maintain clear and current cost planning records for assigned projects, workstreams, or business unit support areas. Support Stage Gate reviews by checking cost planning readiness, completeness, compliance, and alignment with required deliverables. Coordinate with business units, development teams, design teams, commercial, procurement, finance, project controls, digital teams, and external consultants to support integrated cost planning outcomes. Support early-stage cost advice, feasibility input, benchmark checks, and pre-concept cost planning where required before the appointment of project cost consultants. Assist with the briefing, mobilisation, coordination, and performance monitoring of executive and project cost consultants. Track scope and cost movements across project phases and escalate material changes, risks, opportunities, and non-compliance issues in a timely and structured manner. Apply benchmarking data, cost planning software, digital tools, and cost planning analytics to support the review and validation of cost positions. Support business unit cost planning capability through training, onboarding, guidance, and adoption of Qiddiya ways of working. Contribute to the preparation of cost planning review packs, governance papers, leadership updates, dashboards, and trackers. Promote consistent ways of working, professional standards, and continuous improvement across the cost planning community. Accountability for Cost Consultants While external cost consultants may prepare detailed cost plans, estimates, and related analyses, Qiddiya retains accountability for the recommended cost planning position. The Senior Manager supports this by coordinating consultant deliverables, reviewing assigned outputs, recording comments and actions, and escalating key cost planning issues to leadership. This ensures consultant outputs align with Qiddiya Cost Planning Technical Guidelines, reflect approved briefs and design status, include appropriate assumptions and reconciliations, identify risks and opportunities, and provide reliable support for project and governance decisions. Key Interfaces Business Unit cost planning leadership and team members CDU Cost Planning, business unit development teams, and project teams Development Management Office and Stage Gate stakeholders Design management teams and design consultants Commercial, procurement, finance, project controls, digital, and implementation teams Executive cost consultants and project cost consultants Benchmarking, data analytics, and CostX / digital enablement teams Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 12 years of relevant experience in cost planning or a related field. Demonstrated ability to apply consistent cost planning standards across diverse business units and development assets. Experience in coordinating cost planning activities and reviewing consultant outputs. Proficiency in using benchmarking data, cost planning software, and digital tools for cost validation.

c8004e797e9ff10c.description: About the Role Business Management Company (BMC) is establishing a Unified Service Operation Center (USOC) in Riyadh to support critical telecom network infrastructure and enterprise services. We are seeking a Senior SOC Automation & Integration Assurance Specialist to join our team. This is a full-time position for an experienced leader who will contribute to running 24/7 operations, ensuring SLA performance, and driving continuous improvement. Role Context and Objectives The specialist will play a key role in the USOC, focusing on the automation and integration aspects of Security Operations Center functions. This position is critical for maintaining high operational standards and ensuring the seamless delivery of services within a complex telecom environment. Key Responsibilities Lead multidisciplinary teams across monitoring, incident management, assurance, and field maintenance. Own Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), Service Level Agreements (SLAs), escalation procedures, and management reporting. Direct major incident response and service restoration efforts. Govern problem and change management processes, as well as service improvement plans. Coach and develop team members to enhance their skills and performance. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in SOC operations, automation, and integration. Demonstrated leadership experience in managing operational teams. Proven ability to manage SLAs and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, where the Unified Service Operation Center is being established. The role involves working in a dynamic 24/7 operational environment, supporting critical telecom infrastructure and enterprise services. Application Process Qualified candidates are invited to apply for this leadership role within Business Management Company (BMC).

c80a90a2fc0a9416.description: About the Role alfanar Electric, part of alfanar Group, is seeking an Authorization Manager to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position is crucial for managing and maintaining the Delegation of Authority (DoA) across the organization, ensuring robust governance and operational efficiency. The role focuses on aligning business processes with access controls and governance policies to support secure and compliant operations. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to manage and maintain the Delegation of Authority (DoA) framework throughout the organization. This involves ensuring that operational authorities are effectively designed, assigned, and monitored to support secure, compliant, and efficient business operations, aligning them with existing business processes, access controls, and governance policies. Key Responsibilities Support the design, review, and enhancement of Delegation of Authority frameworks in coordination with relevant stakeholders. Coordinate and follow up on DoA approvals, updates, and implementation to ensure effective governance and accountability. Serve as the primary point of contact for end-user inquiries related to delegated authorities within the assigned business scope. Analyze existing and new business processes to define and align appropriate authorization and approval requirements. Develop, maintain, and update operational authority matrices aligned with approved processes, procedures, and coding structures. Ensure delegated authorities and access permissions are clearly defined, accurately assigned, and controlled in line with approved delegations. Risk Management and Control Review and assess risks associated with authorization design, access permissions, and the effectiveness of Delegation of Authority controls. Implement and monitor control measures to mitigate segregation of duties (SoD) and access-related risks. Analyze the utilization of granted authorizations and permissions, recommending adjustments or restrictions where necessary. Prepare and maintain documentation of authorization risk assessments, mitigation actions, and approved risk acceptance decisions in both business and technical terms. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess 6-10 years of relevant experience. The position requires a professional who can effectively manage and maintain organizational authorization frameworks. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within alfanar Electric. The role involves working collaboratively with various stakeholders across the organization to ensure effective governance and accountability.

c84d1c259d650538.description: About KBR KBR, Inc. is a company driven by innovation and collaboration, committed to improving the world responsibly and safely. The company fosters a diverse workforce, attracting skilled professionals whose expertise is rooted in creativity and resourcefulness. The Role of Rotating Technician KBR is seeking a Rotating Technician to join its team in the Eastern region. This full-time role involves ensuring the optimal condition of rotating equipment, performing installations, and executing maintenance and repair tasks on rotating equipment and mechanical systems according to established standards. The candidate MUST be a Saudi National. Key Responsibilities Allocate maintenance activities to technicians and assemble teams as required. Supervise ongoing jobs and provide progress updates to the Foreman. Organize manpower resources, equipment, and material availability for tasks. Arrange necessary work permits before commencing work activities. Provide technical guidance to technicians on the correct use of tools and equipment. Coordinate with Operations, Maintenance Planning, and Technical departments to ensure job execution and completion. Ensure accurate SAP data input, history, and actual hours are maintained. Attend daily and weekly maintenance progress meetings. Maintain strict compliance with SATORP standards and guidelines. Ensure adherence to safe work practices, hazardous work regulations, and proper PPE usage as per SATORP standards. Encourage the reporting of near misses, unsafe conditions, and acts. Participate in Safety audits. Attend scheduled Safety and Technical training sessions. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in maintaining rotating equipment. Demonstrated ability to carry out installation, maintenance, and repair of rotating equipment and mechanical systems. Proficiency in supervising maintenance activities and coordinating with various departments. Strong understanding of safety regulations and compliance within an industrial setting. Work Environment and Compliance This role operates within a structured environment where adherence to SATORP standards, safety protocols, and continuous improvement through training are paramount. The Rotating Technician will be an integral part of a team focused on operational excellence and safety.

c8613ed6cfa31f9a.description: About MoonTech MoonTech is an agentic AI company specializing in creator commerce, focused on guaranteed conversions. The company operates as an autonomous closed-loop system, utilizing 7 specialized AI agents (Moon AI) to manage the full campaign lifecycle. This includes client brief, creator matching, live execution, real-time ad optimization, and verified sales attribution, replacing traditional platform tools and superficial metrics. Role Overview MoonTech is seeking a Business Development Executive for a full-time, execution-focused role to support the company's growth strategy. This position is based in the Eastern Region, specifically in Riyadh or Dammam. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving qualified pipeline generation, supporting brand acquisition efforts, and contributing to revenue growth through structured outreach and deal execution. This role is suitable for professionals with 2-5 years of experience who thrive in a hands-on environment and aim to develop commercial and sales capabilities within a high-growth product company. Key Responsibilities Build and maintain a consistent top-of-funnel pipeline through outbound prospecting and inbound follow-ups. Support brand acquisition efforts, including outreach, pitching support, and deal coordination. Clearly communicate MoonTech’s value proposition regarding performance, control, and ROI to potential clients. Engage with prospects to understand their goals and assist in translating them into platform-based campaign opportunities. Maintain accurate tracking of pipeline activity, lead status, and conversion progress. Assist in improving outreach messaging, targeting, and campaign positioning. Collaborate with Product, Growth, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth handover and onboarding. Support improvements in sales processes and playbooks through feedback and execution insights. Performance Metrics Performance in this role will be measured against several key indicators, including: Number of qualified leads generated per month. Pipeline conversion rate (lead → meeting → deal support). Outbound activity metrics (emails, calls, meetings booked). Contribution to monthly revenue targets (support role). Time-to-first-meeting and responsiveness. CRM hygiene and pipeline accuracy. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will work closely with senior team members to convert leads into active clients, ensuring strong alignment between client goals and platform capabilities. This role requires a professional who can effectively manage a sales pipeline and contribute to revenue growth within a dynamic environment.

c8fc88bb167e823c.description: About the Role Sealy Mattress Middle East is seeking a Receptionist to manage front-desk operations and provide administrative support. This full-time role serves as the primary ambassador for the company, welcoming corporate clients and ensuring smooth office workflows. The ideal candidate will have 5-10 years of relevant experience. Role Purpose The Receptionist is responsible for representing the company professionally, managing all aspects of the front desk, and offering high-level administrative assistance. This position is crucial for maintaining an organized and efficient office environment and for providing a positive first impression to all visitors. Key Responsibilities Greet visitors, corporate partners, and suppliers with a professional demeanor and direct them to the appropriate department. Manage a multi-line switchboard, filter incoming calls, and track general corporate email inquiries promptly. Coordinate incoming and outgoing couriers, manage meeting room schedules, and maintain an organized inventory of office supplies. Maintain workplace security protocols by accurately logging visitor details and issuing security badges. Required Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in a similar front-desk or administrative support role. Work Type This is a full-time position. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply.

c81006331087473f.description: Responsibilities Develop and maintain maintenance SOPs, workflows, inspection standards, and quality-control procedures. Monitor fleet and workshop performance KPIs, including fleet availability, preventive maintenance compliance, repeat repairs, breakdowns, and workshop utilization. Maintain accurate and up-to-date fleet maintenance data and records, including mileage, maintenance history, breakdowns, repair costs, and supporting documentation. Validate and process maintenance and supplier invoices against approved work orders, contractual rates, and completed services; resolve discrepancies and track approvals and payments through completion. Monitor maintenance vendor performance against contractual KPIs, including turnaround time, repair quality, response time, and cost performance. Analyze breakdowns, recurring failures, accidents, and maintenance trends, conduct root-cause analysis, and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Coordinate vehicle inspections and ensure vehicles meet company safety requirements and applicable regulatory standards before returning to service. Prepare Monthly dashboards and management reports covering Pool Vehicle reservation, availability, maintenance costs, vendor performance, key risks, and improvement actions. Coordinate with stakeholder to prioritize repairs and maintenance activities based on operational requirements, vehicle availability, and service criticality. Ensure maintenance records and supporting documentation remain accurate, audit-ready, and compliant with internal policies and contractual requirements. Coordinate with Finance, Procurement, suppliers, and relevant stakeholders to resolve invoice and payment issues and ensure timely closure. Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Automotive Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. 2–4 years of experience in fleet maintenance planning, workshop operations, automotive maintenance, or fleet analysis. Strong Microsoft Excel skills and working knowledge of Power BI, particularly for maintenance dashboards and cost analysis. Good understanding of preventive and corrective maintenance, vehicle lifecycle, and maintenance cost analysis. Experience working with workshops, dealerships, leasing companies, and spare-parts suppliers. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends and provide practical recommendations.

c816f67da58674b5.description: About the Role Bupa Arabia is seeking a Manager - Pre Authorization (Pipeline) to join their team in Al Khobar. This full-time role focuses on ensuring that pre-authorization decisions for medical services are compliant with regulations and medical standards, thereby controlling medical expenditure while safeguarding member health. Role Purpose and Context The primary objective of this position is to manage and control medical spend for both In-Patient and Out-Patient services. This involves ensuring that all pre-authorization decisions adhere to defined SAMA & CCHI regulations, accepted medical guidelines, and high-quality medical standards. The role is critical in aligning decisions with Bupa Values and protecting the health and safety of members. Key Responsibilities Adjudicate In-Patient and Out-Patient cases based on common medical practice and Bupa protocols and policies. Ensure decisions align with medical standards and agreement terms to prevent abuse, fraud, and overtreatment. Maintain a high quality of decision-making with a Zero Quality Demerit Index (QDI) A or B. Ensure consistency in medical decisions, implementing them based on organization-approved clinical and practice guidelines. Achieve daily targets for productivity and response speed. Interpret and utilize clinical skills effectively. Report all high-value claims according to established processes. Identify and report instances of fraud, abuse, and anti-selection. Apply the terms and conditions of Bupa declaration policy in SME products and follow CCHI policy terms and conditions. Continuously upgrade knowledge and experience to meet evolving challenges. Offer professional support and provide positive feedback to team members, assisting in problem-solving. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 3 to 5 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Demonstrated ability to make high-quality medical decisions. Understanding of SAMA & CCHI regulations and medical guidelines. Skills and Competencies Strong analytical and decision-making skills. Ability to interpret and apply clinical guidelines. Commitment to maintaining high customer satisfaction. Proficiency in identifying and reporting compliance issues. Team collaboration and problem-solving abilities. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, focusing on a structured environment that emphasizes compliance, quality medical decisions, and efficient service management. The role requires adherence to Bupa Values and a commitment to continuous professional development.

c88c5b1a84c3fb47.description: About the Role WSP in the Middle East is seeking an experienced Mechanical Engineer to provide full-time construction supervision for the mechanical process systems within a District Cooling Plant (DCP). This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires a professional with over 10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Provide day-to-day site supervision of mechanical installation works related to chilled water production processes within the DCP. Monitor the installation of major mechanical equipment and associated systems, including chillers, cooling towers, pumps, heat exchangers, valves, and chemical treatment systems. Review installations against approved IFC drawings, P&IDs, equipment layouts, technical specifications, and approved material submissions. Identify installation defects, deviations, and potential interface issues, coordinating with relevant engineers and client representatives to resolve technical and site issues. Monitor the progress of mechanical activities against planned construction milestones. Technical and Quality Oversight Review contractor method statements, material submittals, shop drawings, and technical documentation for mechanical process installations. Ensure contractor works comply with approved project documentation and applicable engineering standards. Monitor the implementation of project QA/QC requirements daily, reviewing and signing off Material Inspection Requests (MIRs) and Work Inspection Requests (WIRs). Conduct inspections of mechanical equipment and installations, identifying non-conforming work and raising NCRs and technical concerns as required. Follow up on corrective actions and verify the closure of observations and NCRs. Reporting and Coordination Collaborate with the client's site team and other project stakeholders. Support technical communication with the end client, contractors, and consultants. Participate in project/site coordination meetings and maintain records of inspections, observations, NCRs, and construction progress. Contribute to monthly progress and construction supervision reports. Handover and Close-Out Review mechanical as-built drawings and relevant close-out documentation. Review handover packages for chilled water production process-related mechanical systems. Support the close-out of outstanding defects, NCRs, and punch-list items. Verify the completeness of required construction records and quality documentation prior to handover. Qualifications and Experience Education: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline. Experience: 10-15 years of relevant experience, with significant site/construction supervision exposure. Industry Knowledge: Strong experience in District Cooling Plants, chilled water systems, central utility plants, large HVAC/process cooling plants, or similar infrastructure projects. Technical Skills: Sound knowledge of rotating equipment, pumps, heat exchangers, chillers, cooling towers, valves, and mechanical/process piping. Supervision Background: Previous consultant/client-side construction supervision experience is highly desirable. Quality Processes: Good understanding of MIR/WIR, ITP, Method Statements, NCR, and construction quality processes. Standards: Familiarity with relevant ASHRAE, ASME, ASTM, and applicable local/project standards. Documentation: Strong ability to read P&IDs, IFC drawings, equipment layouts, and mechanical technical specifications. Communication: Excellent communication, coordination, and technical reporting skills.

c80eae25d1c91a03.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة مصنع اساس للصناعة عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية، ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات، وتسجيل العمليات المحاسبية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير المالية اللازمة. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بما يتوافق مع الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال محاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات. معرفة جيدة بإعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية. القدرة على تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتوثيق وتحليل الإيرادات والنفقات. دقة عالية في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المالية وحفظها. القدرة على تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل المحاسبي. مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة لإدارة المستندات والسجلات. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزامًا بالعمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة مصنع اساس للصناعة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الوظيفة.

c81ce638793a8682.description: About the Role Abdul Latif Jameel is seeking an Administration Specialist to provide high-level administrative support to the department. This full-time role is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. The specialist will apply knowledge and skills to resolve complex administrative problems independently or collaboratively. Key Responsibilities Implement purchasing procedures to maintain supply and demand security for department operations and ensure optimal value. Organize high-quality catering services. Maintain regular inventory of all incoming goods and submit inventory reports. Ensure all purchase requests are completed correctly, including proper documentation of materials and expenses. Support PIO business units in the proper implementation of ALJ Fixed Assets handling SOP. Perform monthly routine maintenance schedules to monitor CCTV status. Gather market prices, delivery times, and market trends, and implement appropriate direct and indirect purchasing programs. Review orders and identify suitable budget sources before submitting them for daily approval. Implement cost-saving measures by confirming availability with ALJ OSOOL prior to placing purchase orders. Check availability and confirm physical counts of all CCTV cameras in PIO cost centers, create a master list with details and photos, and request new CCTV as needed. Ensure all documentation and records comply with ISO 9001 requirements. Meet PIO 5S requirements, maintaining a clean, shiny, and organized workplace daily. Provide services with adherence to ethics and the ALJ code of honor. Show initiative and recommend improvements to procedures and processes related to the position. Job Context and Framework This role requires basic knowledge in management administration and the ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. The job holder is responsible for fulfilling the department's administrative needs and ensuring daily compliance with department 5S requirements. The position plays a crucial supporting role in implementing purchasing procedures to maintain supply and demand security, as well as in handling fixed asset execution for the department. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in an administrative support role. Proficiency in ALJ Central Procurement, ALJ Fixed Assets, and ALJ Security policies and procedures. Ability to work independently and collaboratively to resolve complex administrative issues. Strong organizational and documentation skills, including adherence to ISO 9001 standards. About Abdul Latif Jameel Abdul Latif Jameel has an international footprint and over 75 years of commercial success. The company is a leading employer across the Middle East, North Africa, and Turkey (MENAT) region, offering opportunities worldwide. Abdul Latif Jameel operates with values of Respect, Innovation, a Pioneering Spirit, and Empowerment, fostering a culture where ideas, people, and successes flourish.

c829fa513f531eca.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة عابد علي الحبشي للمقاولات عن فني مواد إنشائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، بالمنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على فحص واختبار سلوك المواد تحت ظروف مختلفة، وتقديم التوصيات بشأن الاستخدامات العملية والبحث عن البدائل. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية أخذ العينات وإجراء اختبارات الخصائص الكيميائية للمواد، مع توثيق النتائج بدقة. اختبار الخصائص الفيزيائية للمواد، بما في ذلك القوة والمرونة تحت الظروف القاسية، وتوثيق النتائج. تقييم السلامة والموثوقية، والأثر البيئي، وتكاليف المواد المختبرة، لتحديد مدى ملاءمتها للمشاريع والاستخدامات المختلفة، وتقديم التوصيات اللازمة. إجراء البحوث حول المواد البديلة والتكميلية للاستخدامات العملية. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال فحص واختبار المواد الإنشائية. القدرة على إجراء الاختبارات الكيميائية والفيزيائية للمواد. مهارات جيدة في توثيق النتائج وإعداد التقارير. موقع العمل ونوعه هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة عابد علي الحبشي للمقاولات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

c86fc9063bf8945c.description: About Qiddiya Investment Company Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Director - Operational Compliance/ Monitoring (RD 4) to join its team. This is a full-time position focused on ensuring operational compliance and performance monitoring within City Operations. Role Summary The Senior Director will lead FLS (Fire and Life Safety) operational compliance and performance monitoring across City Operations. This includes governance and oversight of the Fire and Rescue Service and FLS compliance within Facilities Management. The role ensures that operational assets, service providers, and response arrangements remain compliant, ready, and effective through risk-based inspections, audits, performance monitoring, and corrective-action management. Key Responsibilities Lead the City Operations FLS operational compliance and monitoring function. Establish an operational FLS compliance framework covering occupied assets, public spaces, Facilities Management, and the Fire and Rescue Service. Provide governance and performance oversight of the Fire and Rescue Service, including contractual requirements, readiness, response capability, staffing, training, equipment, and performance reporting. Monitor Facilities Management delivery of preventive maintenance, inspection, testing, impairment control, and defect rectification for FLS systems. Develop risk-based inspection and audit programs to verify continued compliance across operational assets and service-provider activities. Define FLS operational KPIs and leading indicators, analyze trends, and report material gaps and emerging risks to leadership. Oversee non-compliance, impairment, deficiency, and corrective-action processes, ensuring timely escalation and verified closure. Coordinate FLS interfaces between FM, Asset Management, CCU, SSOC, Operational Resilience, security, and the Fire and Rescue Service. Support emergency preparedness, exercises, incident review, and continual improvement of operational response arrangements. Required Activities and Duties Develop and maintain operational FLS compliance procedures, inspection schedules, dashboards, and action registers. Review FM and FRS service-provider plans, reports, records, and performance against contractual and operational requirements. Monitor critical fire-system impairments and ensure compensatory measures, escalation, and restoration are effectively managed. Conduct or coordinate operational inspections, audits, readiness checks, and targeted assurance reviews. Review incidents, unwanted alarms, system failures, response performance, and recurring deficiencies to identify systemic improvement actions. Provide FLS compliance input to asset changes, events, operational changes, and occupancy decisions. Maintain regulator and Civil Defense interfaces relating to operational FLS compliance and readiness. Contribute to annual business planning, workforce planning, and budget management for the function. Lead, coach, and develop assigned teams and specialist service providers. Promote a culture of accountability, prevention, continual improvement, and evidence-based decision-making. Maintain accurate records and provide timely reports, presentations, and recommendations to City Operations leadership. Perform other related duties consistent with the role and business requirements. Work Type This is a full-time position.

c88453888175ebe9.description: About the Role ABIS is seeking a Document Controller (SMP) to manage, organize, and maintain project documents and records. This full-time role ensures adherence to company procedures and established document control standards, playing a key part in maintaining accurate and accessible project documentation. Key Responsibilities Ensure proper document numbering, classification, filing, and version control for all project documents. Maintain and update electronic documents using Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS), including platforms such as SharePoint and Documentum. Monitor document submissions, revisions, approvals, and distribution to relevant stakeholders. Verify the accuracy, completeness, and compliance of documents with established control procedures. Manage PDF documents, which includes formatting, combining, organizing, and maintaining electronic records. Coordinate with project teams to facilitate the timely submission and retrieval of necessary documents. Maintain structured electronic filing systems to ensure easy access and efficient document retrieval. Prepare and maintain document registers, tracking logs, and status reports. Support document audits and ensure proper archiving of all project documentation. Qualifications and Experience Associate Degree in Technical Engineering Technology. Minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in document control or document management. c89a6f701060130d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ديار المدينة عن كاتب علاقات حكومية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى توفير المعلومات اللازمة لتخليص المعاملات ومتابعة عمليات التخليص، بالإضافة إلى استكمال متطلبات النماذج والمستندات والإجراءات الحكومية. يتطلب الدور أيضاً متابعة معاملات الموظفين بالتنسيق مع الوحدات الخارجية المعنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمعلومات المتعلقة بالوثائق والمستندات والشروط المطلوبة لتخليص المعاملات. تأمين وتوفير الوثائق اللازمة وتخليص المعاملات بفعالية وسرعة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. تحديث واستكمال جميع متطلبات النماذج والمستندات والإجراءات الحكومية بما يتوافق مع القوانين واللوائح المنظمة للعمل. تنفيذ التعليمات المتعلقة بسرية التعاملات والسجلات، والتعامل معها بمهنية عالية. حفظ الوثائق وتبويبها وترتيبها بناءً على الممارسات المتبعة. استقبال استفسارات الموظفين والإجابة عنها، ومتابعة معاملاتهم بالتنسيق مع موظفي الوحدات الخارجية المعنية. إحاطة الموظفين بكافة المستجدات المتعلقة بمعاملاتهم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة بالعلاقات الحكومية أو تخليص المعاملات. فهم جيد للإجراءات الحكومية ومتطلباتها. القدرة على التعامل مع الوثائق والمستندات الرسمية بدقة واحترافية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة وقدرة على إدارة الوقت. دقة عالية في جمع البيانات وتخليص المعاملات. القدرة على التواصل الفعال مع الجهات الداخلية والخارجية. الالتزام بالسرية والمهنية في التعامل مع المعلومات الحساسة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق متخصص، ويتطلب التنسيق المستمر مع الوحدات الخارجية لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

c8aafe9b9641e9da.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إعمار المأوى للمقاولات عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال وصيانة المعدات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات لخطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية، وتحديد مساراتها بدقة. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل والمشاريع الصناعية. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. وضع برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية، بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب التقدم، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بتشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق شركة إعمار المأوى للمقاولات في مدينة مكة المكرمة، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على تنفيذ المشاريع الكهربائية بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. المنطقة: مكة المكرمة. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الكهربائيين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور في شركة إعمار المأوى للمقاولات.

c83b2cdb8b7ed8e5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة بيت التكييف للمقاولات عن فني صيانة مبانٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة خطط الصيانة الدورية للأبنية، وتحديد المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الطارئة والدورية، بالإضافة إلى كيل الأعمال المنجزة وإعداد المطالبات المالية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى فني صيانة المباني مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان كفاءة عمليات الصيانة، وتشمل: دراسة تفاصيل خطط الصيانة الدورية لمختلف الأبنية، وتحديد العيوب الفنية، ومناقشة طرق معالجتها مع المهندس المختص. إعداد قوائم بالمواد اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة المختلفة، بالإضافة إلى تحديد الأدوات والمعدات والعمال المطلوبين لإنجاز العمل. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، والتحقق من مطابقة الأعمال المنفذة للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. توضيح تفاصيل المخططات للمرؤوسين، ومتابعة دوام فرق العمل المختلفة، ورفع تقارير دورية حول الأعمال المنجزة. كيل الأعمال المنجزة، وحساب كمياتها وتدقيقها، وإعداد المطالبات المالية بالتنسيق مع محاسب الكميات، وتسليم الأعمال لجهة الإشراف. المؤهلات والخبرة لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال صيانة المباني أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الفنية ومواصفات العمل. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والعمل ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في صيانة المباني. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة تساهم في تطوير المهارات المهنية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. نشجع المرشحين الذين يمتلكون الشغف بالعمل الفني والالتزام بالجودة على التقديم.

c8b4d643557b7d94.description: We're looking for a Tech Principal to lead technical strategy and execution on our most ambitious product work: lighthouse projects inside Thoughtworks' global Customer Experience, Product and Design team. Here's the shape of it. A client arrives with a big idea and not much time. Within a few days, you've helped them turn it into a concept everyone agrees on. Within a few weeks, there's something real that customers can actually use and react to. Within a quarter, it's live. Then you do it again, somewhere else in the world, with a different team, and you leave both of them better at it than they were before. If you have built a career integrating strategy, architecture, AI engineering, and executive collaboration, this role offers an ideal platform to leverage those skills. The approach you'd be leading: We call it 3/3/3 3 days: Product concept. Everyone aligned on scope, objectives and how we'll measure success. 3 weeks: Working prototype. Desirability, viability and feasibility tested with real users. 3 months: MLP launch. A production-grade minimum lovable product, ready to keep evolving. Think of it as a reference tempo rather than a fixed schedule. The sequence is what we believe in: align quickly, get real evidence early, put something usable in front of customers while the idea is still current. A regulated platform with a heavy integration surface won't run like a greenfield mobile app, and reading the difference is part of the job. AI runs through all of it, and not as a feature we add at the end. We use AI across the whole lifecycle, from specification and design through build, test and operations, and you'd be one of the people defining what good looks like there. Who You'd Work With We work in tight forward-deployed pods: one Product Strategist, one Experience Designer, and two Forward-Deployed Engineers. You're one of the FDEs — the lead engineer on the pod — guiding architecture, delivery cadence, and technical commercial choices, while collaborating with the strategist and designer as equal partners rather than a downstream requirements queue. Some of the best moments in this job happen when team members explore a challenge from complementary perspectives and unlock innovative solutions. On larger programmes you'll lead across multiple pods, each running its own 3/3/3 rhythm — sometimes a mix of Product Innovation, Modernization/Engineering and Data & AI pod types depending on the engagement shape. You'd report to Ahmet Sakar, Director of Technology for CXPD, and operate as part of a small Tech Principal cadre collaborating directly as peers. Lighthouse projects come in all sizes. Sometimes it's one pod and a single product bet. Sometimes it's a multi-year programme with several streams running at once, real platform and modernization work underneath, and a steering committee to keep alongside. Either way, the work is visible, and when it lands it becomes the case study, the reference architecture and the talk you get invited to give. How Autonomous You Are This is a Tech Principal role, not a Tech Lead. Within Thoughtworks' Radar and CXPD's delivery standards, you make the calls: architecture patterns, stack selection, pod composition for your engagements, commercial pricing tolerances within the band, and the technical position in a pitch. Ahmet is the escalation point for the largest bets, cross-region consistency questions, and firm-wide precedent — everything else lands with you. This isn't a role where every decision gets a second look before it lands with the client. Working in KSA This role anchors in Riyadh, working across the Kingdom's most ambitious digital bets — Vision 2030-aligned government transformation, PIF-family portfolio companies, financial services, energy, retail and public sector. Expect regulated-industry delivery, data-residency requirements under PDPL, and a client base where Arabic-language proficiency is an asset, though not a strict requirement. Job responsibilities Shaping the bet. Running concept sprints with client executives, product managers and designers. Turning a broad ambition into something scoped and testable. Agreeing what success looks like, and what would tell us to stop, before anyone writes code. Winning the work. Partnering with account leads to shape technical narratives on new pursuits. Supporting the pod construct and 3/3/3 commercial arc with client leaders with a clear understanding of pricing parameters. Owning technical scope in proposals, presenting confidently, and maintaining focus when discovery reveals core project requirements. Proving it. Setting the technical direction for prototyping: what to build, what to fake, what to buy, and what evidence each prototype needs to produce. Pairing with designers and engineers so prototypes can actually be tested with users. Standing up proper evaluation for anything AI-powered, including golden datasets, offline evals, human review, guardrails, and cost and latency budgets. Landing it. Owning an architecture that ships in three months and stands up long-term. Establishing delivery systems around it: agentic workflows with human oversight, continuous delivery, test strategy, observability, security, and privacy by design. On larger initiatives, maintaining architectural alignment across streams so each can ship independently. Advising. Serving as a trusted technology advisor to key stakeholders. Aligning technical options with business outcomes. Presenting to steering committees, facilitating executive workshops, and shaping new opportunities with client partners. Developing team members. Pairing, reviewing code, and mentoring colleagues. Creating reusable practices to support team continuity. Mentoring engineers onto lighthouse projects and sharing knowledge broadly across internal and external communities. Job Qualifications Technical Skills Programming languages: Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript, with working knowledge of the other, alongside experience shipping production code in at least one additional language. AI & LLM ecosystems: Hands-on experience with major LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Vertex), RAG and vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Elastic), and agent frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex). AI evaluation & observability: Proficiency in offline/online evaluations, golden datasets, LLM-as-judge patterns, tracing, and cost monitoring using tools like Braintrust, LangSmith, Langfuse, or custom harnesses. AI-assisted development & prototyping: Active adoption of AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Replit) and rapid prototyping platforms (v0, Lovable, Figma Make) to accelerate delivery. Cloud platforms & DevOps: Deep expertise in AWS, GCP, or Azure, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), containerization (Kubernetes, Docker), and automated CI/CD pipelines. Software architecture & integration: Solid foundation in API design, event-driven streaming (Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub), microservices, and integrating with enterprise legacy systems. Data engineering & analytics: Experience with modern data platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks) and orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, Dagster) to design architectures for AI workloads. Frontend development & modern practices: Capability to build prototypes using React/Next.js, alongside engineering practices like TDD, pair programming, continuous deployment, and threat modeling (OWASP LLM). Governance, security & compliance: Experience delivering under complex regulatory environments (GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, Saudi PDPL, or EU AI Act) and high-security standards. Regional & cross-cultural engagement: Experience delivering in GCC markets or international settings, with Arabic language proficiency or public advocacy (talks, open source, publications) being a strong plus. c815af502e608340.description: Eram Talent is seeking a skilled Scada Technician to join a prominent client in Saudi Arabia within the Oil & Gas industry. The Scada Technician will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to optimize system performance and provide timely technical support. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing hardware and software components of SCADA systems, performing system upgrades, and conducting preventive maintenance activities. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work in a dynamic environment and contribute to critical infrastructure projects. Responsibilities Install, configure, and maintain SCADA system hardware and software components. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to SCADA communications, data acquisition, and control systems. Conduct routine inspections and preventive maintenance to ensure system reliability and availability. Collaborate with engineering, operations, and IT teams to implement system upgrades and improvements. Maintain detailed documentation, including system configurations, maintenance activities, and incident reports. Ensure compliance with safety policies and industry standards in all SCADA-related activities. Provide technical support and training to operators and junior technicians as needed. Familiarity with network configurations, cybersecurity practices, and industrial communication standards. Proficient troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in team environments. Willingness to work in Saudi Arabia and adapt to local work conditions.

c8df957792a99635.description: The Project Manager will lead and manage railway safety and inspection activities for key railway operation and maintenance projects across Saudi Arabia. The role requires extensive experience in railway systems focusing on safety compliance, technical inspection, accident investigation, and regulatory oversight, ensuring the highest standards of railway operation safety. Responsibilities: Conduct scheduled supervisory visits and technical inspections at major railway projects (e.g., Haramain High-Speed Railway, Riyadh Metro, Etihad Rail). Lead on-site investigations immediately following railway accidents or incidents. Prepare and submit detailed monitoring and investigation reports within prescribed timelines (usually within two weeks). Review, update, and contribute to railway policies, regulations, and procedural documents as requested by regulatory authorities. Participate in meetings with railway operators and government transport authorities, both remote and in-person. Verify operator compliance with safety certifications, operating licenses, and regulatory requirements during inspections. Provide continuous technical support and respond promptly to queries from the Authority staff between site visits. Ensure all inspection and investigation activities strictly comply with official safety standards and protocols. Minimum of 20 years’ experience in railway systems, safety, operation, and maintenance (O&M). Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Safety Management, or related technical field. Master’s degree is preferred. Proven experience conducting technical investigations of railway accidents or incidents. Hands-on experience with railway operation, maintenance protocols, and safety standards. Prior experience working on railway projects in Saudi Arabia or GCC countries is highly desirable. Strong knowledge of international best practices for railway safety and inspection.
